verdicts.rationale: REST v2 API accepts invalid consistencyLevel values when passed at top-level JSON field, bypassing validation that exists for params.consistencyLevel. Root cause: CollectionReq struct lacks ConsistencyLevel field present in QueryReqV2/SearchReqV2, causing top-level field to be ignored during unmarshalling. gRPC path correctly rejects invalid values (verified via pymilvus test). This is cross-channel inconsistency - REST v2 accepts what gRPC rejects, matching known blindspot pattern.
